props.name: source
props.comment: Record field holding the status, a top-level key. Default `"status"`.

props.name: guards
props.comment: Predicates keyed `"<from>-><to>"`. A transition with no guard is allowed.

props.name: labels
props.comment: Display text by state. A state with no entry shows as itself.

props.name: confirm
props.comment: Ask for confirmation before moving the record. Default `false`.

props.name: mutationMode
props.comment: How the update is dispatched. Default `"pessimistic"`.
